correctness.rationale: Each distinct run-letter c_i appears only in its own run, forcing at least one attractor position per run. Picking all run endpoints attains q. Each mixed adjacent bigram c_i c_{i+1} occurs once, forcing last(i) or first(i+1), which also suffices for any mixed factor; pure c_i^t has a sliding occurrence through any chosen position. Singleton runs split independent non-singleton blocks; a t-run block has t+1 all-endpoint configurations plus Σ(a_i−2) configurations with one interior choice, totaling 1+Σ(a_i−1). Block sequence GF yields xy/((1−x)(1−x−xy−x²y)), with [y^q] x^q(1+x)^{q−1}/(1−x)^{q+1}, hence binomial sum. Independent direct-occurrence enumeration covered 117 run vectors (lengths 1..3, 2..4 runs) and 30 coefficient comparisons; those are corroboration, not the proof.
residual_risks: Pairwise distinctness of run symbols is essential; no circular or repeated-symbol extension.
